{{Top|leg}}
'''Energy scanners''' were used to detect a wide range of energy emissions. They could detect data on the emission's type, intensity, effect, and origin. Energy scanners could distinguish between artificial and natural energy types,<ref name="Scanners">{{JournalCite|4|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide: Scanners}}</ref> and could determine if the emissions indicated the presence of weapon [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power pack]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[9000 Energy Scanner]] was a type of energy scanner.<ref name="Scanners" />
